title: The Coward's Cave
text: A cave full of people hiding from something, dozens of them packed into the dark, so quiet you can hear their hearts. Their eyes shine in the torchlight. They beg the party to take their scraps and go, quietly, before it hears you.

options.label: The meekest of you speaks to them, gently, one frightened soul to another.

outcomes.text: They whisper to the meek one what they are hiding from, and where it sleeps, and how it eats. The meek one does not sleep that night.

options.label: Take their scraps and go, quietly, before it hears you.

outcomes.text: A little food, a little shame, and their eyes in the dark following you out.

options.label: Go and hunt what they fear, so they need not hide any longer.

outcomes.text: It is awake, and it is bigger than they said, and it has been waiting for someone brave enough.
